spec.description: Operations-permission policy decisions, search-lane scoping, snapshot reads, compiles and their costs, from the boxel:operations channel. See the operations-diagnosis skill for how to read it.

panels.description: Policy decisions in the last 5 minutes of the range: allow, deny and error, decided at the gate or under the write lock. Explain decisions (hypothetical) and capability checks are not counted.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome=~"allow|deny|error" | hypothetical="false" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Decisions (5m)

panels.description: Denied decisions in the last 5 minutes, any reason. A card the index has no row for (reason target-missing) counts too.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="deny" | hypothetical="false" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Denials (5m)

panels.description: Decisions where a predicate threw (reason predicate-threw), whatever the caller was told: a caller who may not read the realm gets a 404 for it, so a 500 count misses these.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | reason="predicate-threw" | hypothetical="false" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Predicate errors (5m)

panels.description: Compiles in the last 5 minutes that produced a policy that did not compile as a whole. Every caller such a realm reaches only through its policy is refused with a 500.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-compile" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | uncompilable="true" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Uncompilable policies (5m)

panels.description: Every real policy decision, by outcome. Gate: one record per decision — a read at the gate; a write the gate admits or refuses outright at the gate; a write left to the write lock under the lock (its gate record says pending and is left out here). Search: one record per realm a search consulted through its policy — scoped (some grant admits rows), none, or failed. Explain decisions are hypothetical and left out.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome=~"allow|deny|error" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Decisions by outcome

panels.description: How often callers the realm ACL declined reach the policy gate, by realm and by what the ACL declined (all, or writes only). A caller the ACL allows never reaches the gate and records nothing, so a realm whose callers are all realm-authorized should sit at zero; traffic here for such a realm means the ordering guarantee broke. Capability checks are excluded: they are their own kind. A write the gate leaves to the lock counts here once, as its gate-time pending record; a pending record with no lock record after it is a write whose request ended before the lock (a failed batch, an aborted request, an explain), not a backlog.

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL, coarseDeclined) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | decidedAt="gate" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

sum by (realmURL) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Gate reach by realm

panels.description: Denials over the selected range, by realm, the reason, the rules matched on the target's type and the grants in them for the operation. A `predicate` reason means every listed grant's predicate was evaluated and none held; an empty grant list means no grant names the operation. Query B adds searches a realm's policy scoped to nothing (search-lane outcome none), by realm and the query they ran.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (realmURL, operation, reason, rules, grants) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="deny" | hypothetical="false" [$__range])))

topk(25, sum by (realmURL, operation, transport) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="none" | hypothetical="false" [$__range])))

panels.title: Denials by rule and grant

panels.description: Real decisions by the surface that reached the gate: envelope (_operations), card-json (GET/HEAD/POST/PATCH/DELETE), byte-route (source/module), internal.

targets.expr: sum by (transport, route) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome=~"allow|deny|error" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Decisions by transport

panels.description: A: decisions where a predicate threw, from the decision records. B: the realm:policy fault warning, which logs at most one line per predicate per minute, so B undercounts and is the place to read the error itself. B also counts throws under an explain or a capability check, which A leaves out, so B can rise while A stays flat.

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | reason="predicate-threw" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "a predicate in the policy of realm" |= "${realm}" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Predicate error rate

panels.description: Compiles (and revalidations) of a realm's policy that left it uncompilable, by realm. Also counts decisions refused because the policy could not be loaded.

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-compile" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | uncompilable="true" [$__interval]))

sum by (realmURL) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | reason="policy-unavailable" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Policies failing to compile, per realm

panels.description: One record per realm a search consulted through its policy: scoped (some grant contributed a filter), none, or failed (the policy could not be judged; the realm counts as not answering). By transport: search, federated-search, envelope (an entry's query target).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, transport) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Search-lane outcomes

panels.description: Which grants contributed filters to scoped searches over the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (realmURL, operation, grants) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="scoped" | hypothetical="false" [$__range])))

panels.title: Contributing grants

panels.description: Each evaluation of a predicate annotated snapshot: true, at the gate or under the write lock: a window, measured in index latency, during which a card that no longer satisfies the predicate is still admitted.

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL, grant, decidedAt) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-snapshot-read" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Snapshot reads by grant

panels.description: Whether the predicate held, did not hold, or threw against the snapshot; indexed=false means the target had no index row and so was not admitted.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, indexed) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-snapshot-read" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Snapshot reads by outcome

panels.description: evaluationMs: from the gate's entry to its answer — typing the target, loading the (cached) policy, matching rules, and evaluating predicates. Under the lock, the lock's own re-judgment.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" | unwrap evaluationMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" | unwrap evaluationMs [$__interval]) by ()

panels.title: Decision evaluation duration p50/p95

panels.description: predicateMs: time spent evaluating predicates within one decision (only decisions that evaluated any). The rest of evaluationMs is matching and reading the target.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | predicates > 0 | hypothetical="false" | unwrap predicateMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-decision" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | predicates > 0 | hypothetical="false" | unwrap predicateMs [$__interval]) by ()

panels.title: Predicate time p50/p95

panels.description: evaluationMs of judging one realm's policy for one search: matching query grants and lowering their filters.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" | unwrap evaluationMs [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-search-scope" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | hypothetical="false" | unwrap evaluationMs [$__interval]) by ()

panels.title: Search-lane duration p50/p95

panels.description: Policy cache reads of the policy card by realm: compiled (rules rebuilt) or revalidated (still current). A high compile rate means the cache keeps being invalidated.

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL, outcome) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-compile" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Policy compiles

panels.description: durationMs of one compile or revalidation, which a caller waiting on a cold or stale cache pays.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="policy-compile" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | unwrap durationMs [$__interval]) by (outcome)

panels.title: Compile duration p95

panels.description: One record per request from a caller who isn't signed in that reached a realm's anonymous admission (per realm for a federated search): admitted (counted), infra (the platform's own services, never counted), refused (no grant admitted it), blocked (the realm refused the address), rate-limited (the address used up its budget), unavailable (the count couldn't be read). A realm whose policy opens nothing to such callers records nothing.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Anonymous outcomes

panels.description: Requests from callers who aren't signed in answered rate-limited in the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="rate-limited" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rate-limited (5m)

panels.description: Requests from callers who aren't signed in answered blocked in the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="blocked" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Blocked (5m)

panels.description: blocklist: the realm's anonymousBlocklist names the address. ip-undetermined: no address reached the realm, usually a hop misconfiguration. blocklist-invalid: an entry isn't an address or range, which closes the realm to every such caller.

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL, blockReason) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="blocked" [$__range]))

panels.title: Blocked by reason

panels.description: The addresses behind admissions, refusals and rate limits over the selected range, per realm: who to look at before blocking, and whether many visitors share one address (a hop misconfiguration).

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (realmURL, clientIP, outcome) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome=~"admitted|refused|rate-limited|blocked" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top addresses by outcome

panels.description: A: admitted writes by the first user they were made as. B: refused writes whose grants named no one who may write the realm, by the failure (key-missing, not-a-matrix-id, no-write).

targets.expr: sum by (realmURL, actingUser) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="admitted" | json actingUser="actingUsers[0]" | actingUser!="" [$__range]))

sum by (realmURL, failure) (count_over_time({service="realm-server", env="$env"} |= "boxel:operations" | json | line_format "{{ if .log }}{{ .log }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}" | json | channel="boxel:operations" | kind="anonymous-request" | realmURL=~".*${realm}.*" | outcome="refused" | json failure="actingUserFailures[0].failure" | failure!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Anonymous writes by acting user

list.description: Substring of a realm URL. Empty matches every realm.
list.label: Realm
list.name: realm
